# Recreation Prompt

Create a mobile-first portrait browser game called **Castle Charm Drop**. Preserve a Cut-the-Rope-style physics puzzle: a single falling object hangs from one or two rope chains, the player swipes to cut rope segments, gravity and Verlet constraints move the object, three collectibles add 100 points each, reaching a bottom target wins, and leaving bounds fails.

Transform the presentation into a wizard-school Charms lesson. The object is a golden owl-orb familiar, ropes are glowing spell bindings from rune anchors, collectibles are house-point sigils, the target is a potion cauldron, the score is House Points, and the scene is a cozy gothic castle classroom with towers, floating candles, moving stair rails, house banners, spell sparks, parchment HUD, and readable touch-friendly controls. Use browser-native Canvas/CSS/JS in one `index.html`, catalog-approved fantasy fonts/media when safe, and prioritize mobile portrait readability.
blueprint_markdown:
# Blueprint

## Source Truth
The preserved source is a mobile canvas physics puzzle in the Cut-the-Rope family. A single falling object is suspended from one or two rope chains built from Verlet points and sticks. The player starts by tapping, then swipes a pointer trail through rope segments to deactivate sticks. Gravity and rope constraints swing/drop the object. Three optional collectibles add score. Reaching the bottom target wins; leaving the screen bounds fails; restart creates a fresh randomized layout.

## Protected Mechanics
- Pointer tap starts play; swipe gesture cuts active rope segments.
- Verlet point update, gravity 0.5, friction 0.99, ropeStiffness 5, and constraint iteration remain intact.
- Rope cutting uses line-segment intersection.
- Collectibles use 40px-radius proximity and award 100 points each.
- Goal collision uses goal radius plus object radius; out-of-bounds failure is unchanged.
- Start, playing, win/gameover, and restart state flow are preserved.

## Remixed Target
Castle Charm Drop reframes the same mechanics as a wizard-school Charms lesson: a chosen apprentice guides a golden owl-orb familiar through glowing spell bindings, collects house-point sigils, and lands it in a potion cauldron in a cozy gothic castle classroom.

## Safe Transformation Surfaces
HUD language, title, start/result copy, colors, procedural background, focal object drawing, rope/anchor rendering, collectible styling, particle colors, optional catalog audio/GIF feedback, and mobile UI polish.
